class.name: VoxelLightingBake3D
class.brief_description: Bakes and loads starting lighting while preserving dynamic DDGI updates.
class.description: Add one node per world below the authored level root. Select it to use Bake Voxel Lighting in the 3D toolbar. Bake geometry excludes non-static physics bodies and subtrees in the voxel_bake_excluded group. Bounds are in local coordinates. Save the scene after baking so its resource dependency is exported.

method.name: bake
method.description: Starts an asynchronous bake. When save_path is provided, the completed resource is saved before assignment. A failed save or cancellation retains the previous cache.

method.name: get_bake_description
method.description: Describes the current bake view and rendered frame count.

method.name: cancel_bake
method.description: Cancels without saving or assigning partial data.

method.name: compute_signature
method.description: Returns the deterministic authored lighting fingerprint, or an empty string if the source cannot be fingerprinted.

method.name: get_bake_progress
method.description: Returns approximate progress from zero to one.

method.name: is_baking
method.description: Returns whether a bake is running.

method.name: request_cache_status
method.description: Requests renderer cache diagnostics through cache_status. Enabling probe_statistics performs explicit GPU readback for validation; leave disabled during ordinary gameplay.

members.member: Assigned starting-light resource. Missing or stale data uses dynamic lighting.
Root containing authored geometry, lights, and environment.
Local-space region covered by the bake.
Minimum rendered warmup opportunity per view. Probe maturity is checked separately.
Timeout for a view that does not converge.

signal.name: bake_finished
signal.description: Empty on success; otherwise describes failure or cancellation.

signal.name: cache_status
signal.description: Renderer diagnostics including restored_probes and invalidated when a cache is registered.
